@torch.no_grad()
def run(xi,c,graft=None):
    x=xi.clone(); acts=[]
    for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((x.shape[0],),1-k/20)
        v,a=net.velocity(x,t,c,("out_act",),count=False)
        h=a["out_act"]; acts.append(h)
        if graft is not None:
            w,b,off,lo,hi=graft
            if lo<=k<hi:
                f=(h@w+b>0).float()[:,None]; v=v+f*off
        x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy(), torch.stack(acts)

X=H[LO:HI].reshape(-1,128); Y=torch.tensor(np.tile(y,HI-LO)).float()
mu=X.mean(0); sd=X.std(0)+1e-3
w=torch.zeros(128,requires_grad=True); b=torch.zeros(1,requires_grad=True)
opt=torch.optim.Adam([w,b],lr=0.05)
pw=torch.tensor((1-y.mean())/y.mean()*0.3)
for it in range(400):
    opt.zero_grad(); z=((X-mu)/sd)@w+b
    l=torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(z,Y,pos_weight=pw)+1e-3*w.abs().sum()
    l.backward(); opt.step()
wr=(w/sd).detach(); br=(b-(mu/sd*w).sum()).detach()
for th in [-2,-1,0,1,2]:
    z=(H[LO:HI]@wr+br-th)>0  # (steps,N)
